newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends little changed in dull trading.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends little changed in dull trading.

text.p: The won closed little changed versus the dollar on Monday after being trapped in an extremely tight range, dealers said.
The won finished at 888.20 against Friday's closing of 888.30. It traded in a narrow range of 888.10 to 888.50. The won opened at the low end of the range.
Dealers said expectations of month-end export deals and an inflow of foreign funds for equity investment supported the local unit.
However, a slight rise of the dollar/yen in the world markets, combined with import settlements and dollar bargain hunting, kept the won from rising much.
Traders said the won was set to rise above 888 in the near future in absence of dollar-buying intervention by the central Bank of Korea.
